node.statement: For every j define R_j:=sum_{s in Sigma_j}p_js*(U_js^* tensor I_Ej)W_jW_j^*(U_js tensor I_Ej); then R_j=I_Lj tensor C_j for a positive contraction C_j on E_j, and, writing hat-U_js for U_js in the j-th block of B and zero elsewhere, W_j^*R_jW_j=sum_{s in Sigma_j}p_js*Delta(hat-U_js^*)Delta(hat-U_js), so lem-routef-degree-two-estimate, lem-routef-raw-factor-norms, and lem-routef-delta-normalization-closeness give ||C_j|| >= 1-(C_V+C_Delta+C_2)*eta=1-C_R*eta.
